paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Paper derives 95% CL exclusion on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma vs m_a from GW170817 multimessenger (Fermi-LAT) data. Only the two benchmark points (ma=200 MeV, g=1.41e-12 GeV^-1; ma=398 MeV, g=5.01e-11 GeV^-1) are given as explicit numbers in the text; these lie within the excluded region. The full exclusion contour is only available in Fig. 4 (purple shaded region spanning roughly ma ~ a few MeV to ~1 GeV, g ~ 1e-12 to 1e-7 GeV^-1) and could not be read off numerically. This is an astrophysical (merger) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density applies.
